newsitem.title: USA: Washington Gov. signs tax bills to aid counties.
newsitem.headline: Washington Gov. signs tax bills to aid counties.

text.p: Washington state Gov. Gary Locke said Thursday he signed legislation to give an economic boost to cash-strapped rural counties.

"These new laws give the state tools to keep and attract jobs that are essential to healthy, thriving communities," Locke said in a statement. "We're giving tax and regulatory relief that will attract and keep businesses that provide good jobs for Washington families."
* give incentives for new businesses to locate in economically distressed counties and tax credits to existing businesses that hire new workers.
* provide a 0.04 percent state sales tax credit to distressed counties to build infrastructure such as sewer and water systems for new businesses.

* extend programs designed to help counties and workers suffering from job losses in the timber and salmon industries. Workers will continue to get money for services such as rent and mortgage assistance, food banks and counseling.
